title: WE DON'T SPEAK AMERICANO
style:
driving Australian anthem-rock, 124 BPM,
pumping bass line — staccato, locked in tight,
rhythm guitar — choppy, sharp, festival energy,
handclaps and stomp percussion from bar one,
Italian-Mediterranean guitar hook transformed to Southern hemisphere swagger,
didgeridoo pulse on chorus,
group male-female chorus — full, celebratory, defiant,
call and response pre-chorus,
WA coastal pride energy — zero American reference,
spoken bridge — intimate, honest, Aussie accent,
outro full band then single guitar then gone
lyrics:
[Intro – staccato rhythm guitar hits, pumping bass, handclaps immediate]

[Verse 1 – driving, swagger, group energy]
They sold us the dream with the stars and the stripes
We looked at our coast — 12,000 k's right
Indian Ocean on the left, no border in sight
WA doesn't need it — we're already alright

Abrolhos coral — that's our version of gold
Helicopter drops to islands barely told
Two boats, one yard, Malaga sunrise
We don't need their dream — we've got our own prize

[Pre-Chorus – call and response building]
You want the coast? — WA
You want the reef? — right here
You want the dream? — already ours
You want the life? — crystal clear

[Chorus – full festival, group anthemic, didgeridoo pulse]
We don't speak americano
We speak Indian Ocean, WA, Malaga
We speak reef and rotor and boats rebuilt by hand
We speak two mates who turned iron into land

We don't need the other dream —
We've got the real one
From Geraldton south where the coast runs long
Pete and Brandon — WA born
We don't speak americano — we've got our own song

[Verse 2 – tighter, punching]
Deckie on the aft — salt on my face
Brother skips the Pelican — he owns the space
Fisheries watch — compliance tight
We run clean because we respect the right

Clients helicopter in from Perth
They've never seen this — 80 feet of worth
Livewire running, Pelican steady
WA coast — always been ready

[Bridge – half-time, single guitar and one voice, honest]
Mum and Dad came over from New Zealand.
Settled here.
Joel grew up Aussie.
Pete was already the ocean before he could swim it.
Corey watched and learned.
Brandon built it with him.

We didn't look west for a dream.
We looked down.
Into the water.
WA was already everything.

[Chorus – doubled, festival peak]

[Outro – full band hit, then single guitar, then gone]
WA.
Ours.
